assertions.title: Landing page renders and adapts to auth state

steps.action: Open / in a clean signed-out browser session.
steps.expected: The landing page shows the hero, capability cards, How It Works flow, footer, and a signed-out CTA to /sign-up.
steps.observed: The signed-out landing page rendered the Janus hero, capability cards, How It Works flow, footer links, and a primary CTA labelled "Sign Up & Start Building".

steps.action: Revisit / with a corroborated signed-in auth cookie for the isolated account.
steps.expected: The primary CTA changes to Open Dashboard and the auth chip resolves to the signed-in email.
steps.observed: With the corroborated janus_access cookie loaded, / showed an "Open Dashboard" CTA and the landing page copy resolved to "Signed in: frontend-hardening-ut+auth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r@example.com".

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on the landing page in signed-out or signed-in states
evidence.network: Signed-in corroboration via curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202 (op_8e02c14be7eb074a6f0b4a5b), GET /api/v1/operations/op_8e02c14be7eb074a6f0b4a5b -> succeeded, POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200, GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200 for frontend-hardening-ut+auth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r@example.com.

steps.action: Open /sign-in and enter the isolated test email.
steps.expected: Continue enables for a valid email and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: Continue enabled for the valid email and revealed the password field.

steps.action: Inspect the password-step links and submit an invalid password.
steps.expected: Forgot your password? points to /reset-password?email=..., Email sign-in code points to /magic-code?email=..., and invalid credentials show an inline error.
steps.observed: Forgot your password? resolved to /reset-password?email=frontend-hardening-ut%2Bauth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r%40example.com, Email sign-in code resolved to /magic-code?email=frontend-hardening-ut%2Bauth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r%40example.com, and the invalid password attempt rendered the inline message "invalid credentials".

steps.action: Submit the valid password.
steps.expected: Valid credentials redirect to /get-started and the signed-in state can be corroborated.
steps.observed: Submitting Janus!Pass1234 redirected the browser to http://localhost:3000/get-started, and the isolated account's signed-in state was corroborated through operation polling plus /api/v1/auth/me.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the sign-in flow
evidence.network: curl.exe corroboration: POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202 (op_631ca4290a5f0c6d96f1b379), GET /api/v1/operations/op_631ca4290a5f0c6d96f1b379 -> running -> succeeded, POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200, GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200 for frontend-hardening-ut+auth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r@example.com.

steps.action: Open /sign-up and enter the isolated test email.
steps.expected: Continue enables and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: The valid email enabled Continue and revealed the password field.

steps.action: Try a short password and then the assigned valid password.
steps.expected: A short password keeps Create account disabled, while a 10+ character password enables submission.
steps.observed: Create account stayed disabled for "short" and became enabled for Janus!Pass1234. The alternate link on the sign-up page resolved to /sign-in.

steps.action: Submit the form.
steps.expected: Successful sign-up redirects to /get-started and creates a usable account.
steps.observed: Submitting the form changed the browser URL to http://localhost:3000/get-started. A follow-up curl.exe sign-in replay for the same credentials succeeded, confirming the account was created and usable.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the sign-up flow before the post-submit dashboard redirect
evidence.network: Browser submission redirected to /get-started. Corroborating curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202 (op_8e02c14be7eb074a6f0b4a5b), GET /api/v1/operations/op_8e02c14be7eb074a6f0b4a5b -> succeeded, POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200, GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200 for the newly created account.

assertions.title: Magic-code (passwordless) flow works end-to-end

steps.action: Open /magic-code?email=<isolated-email>.
steps.expected: The email is prefilled, the request auto-sends, and six OTP inputs appear.
steps.observed: The page prefilled frontend-hardening-ut+auth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r@example.com, rendered six OTP inputs immediately, initially showed "please wait before requesting another code", and exposed an email preview with the literal placeholder <one_time_code>.

steps.action: Exercise OTP keyboard navigation.
steps.expected: Typing advances focus, ArrowLeft moves back, and Backspace from an empty next field moves back and clears the previous digit.
steps.observed: Typing 1 advanced focus from digit 1 to digit 2, ArrowLeft moved focus back to digit 1, but Backspace from the empty second field only moved focus back and did not clear the previous digit.

steps.action: Enter an invalid 6-digit code.
steps.expected: Entering all 6 digits auto-submits, shows an inline invalid-code error, and resets the digit inputs.
steps.observed: Typing 123456 auto-submitted and reset all six inputs to blank, but the page never rendered any visible invalid-code error text.

steps.action: Wait for resend availability and corroborate the backend request path.
steps.expected: Resend now becomes available and a valid code can complete the redirect to /get-started.
steps.observed: After the cooldown text disappeared, Resend now remained disabled. A cooldown-expired curl.exe retry of POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/request still failed with internal_error "actor not found", so the happy path could not be completed.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on the magic-code page
evidence.network: UI auto-send initially put the endpoint into cooldown. curl.exe corroboration: POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/verify with 123456 -> 202 (op_fdca08c3f442c308667e75b8), GET /api/v1/operations/op_fdca08c3f442c308667e75b8 -> failed unauthorized "invalid one-time code". After cooldown, POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/request -> 202 (op_f23c06ab675d51ada0ff2777), GET /api/v1/operations/op_f23c06ab675d51ada0ff2777 -> failed internal_error "actor not found".

assertions.issues: The passwordless flow did not meet the contract: the happy path could not be completed, Resend now stayed disabled after the cooldown, invalid-code UI feedback was missing, and Backspace did not clear the previous OTP digit.

assertions.title: Reset-password flow works

steps.action: Open /reset-password?email=<isolated-email>.
steps.expected: The email is prefilled.
steps.observed: The email field was prefilled with frontend-hardening-ut+auth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r@example.com.

steps.action: Use the Back to sign-in link.
steps.expected: The link navigates back to /sign-in.
steps.observed: Clicking the back link navigated the browser to http://localhost:3000/sign-in.

steps.action: Submit the reset-password request.
steps.expected: The page shows the reset-instructions success flash or a normal user-facing error state.
steps.observed: The page stayed on /reset-password and rendered the inline text "actor not found" instead of the expected reset-instructions outcome.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on the reset-password page
evidence.network: After waiting out the endpoint cooldown, curl.exe corroboration showed POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password/request -> 202 (op_4de320aa7b5438ed52afe94d), GET /api/v1/operations/op_4de320aa7b5438ed52afe94d -> failed internal_error "actor not found".

assertions.issues: Reset-password did not provide the expected success flash or a normal recovery message; it surfaced the backend actor failure directly in the UI.

steps.action: Open /get-started while signed out.
steps.expected: The topbar shows the active workspace label, signed-out state, and the no-project hint.
steps.observed: The signed-out dashboard topbar showed "Current view: Pipeline", "API /api/v1", "Signed out", and "Create a project in Projects view".

steps.action: Open /get-started with the corroborated signed-in session.
steps.expected: The topbar updates to the signed-in email branch and retains the workspace context.
steps.observed: With the corroborated auth cookie applied, the topbar showed "Current view: Pipeline", "API /api/v1", the signed-in email frontend-hardening-ut+auth-rerun-def2730f6e24u1r@example.com, and a visible Sign Out control.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on the signed-out or signed-in dashboard topbar checks
evidence.network: Signed-in state was corroborated with curl.exe via POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202 (op_631ca4290a5f0c6d96f1b379), GET /api/v1/operations/op_631ca4290a5f0c6d96f1b379 -> succeeded, POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200, and GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200.

steps.action: Reach the authenticated dashboard state for the isolated account.
steps.expected: A Sign Out control is visible in the dashboard topbar.
steps.observed: The signed-in dashboard rendered a visible Sign Out control beside the isolated account email.

steps.action: Click Sign Out.
steps.expected: The app clears auth state and redirects to landing or sign-in.
steps.observed: Clicking Sign Out redirected the browser to http://localhost:3000/sign-in and returned the session to signed-out UI.

steps.action: Corroborate the cleared auth state against the backend.
steps.expected: The signout endpoint succeeds and /api/v1/auth/me rejects the cleared session.
steps.observed: A curl.exe replay returned POST /api/v1/auth/signout -> {"ok":true}, and GET /api/v1/auth/me with the same cookie jar returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the signout click and redirect
evidence.network: Browser click redirected to /sign-in. Corroborating curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/signout -> {"ok":true}; GET /api/v1/auth/me with the same cookie jar -> 401 unauthorized.

frictions.description: The assigned agent-browser session repeatedly became unreadable after browser-driven auth redirects to /get-started, even while localhost:3000 and localhost:8080 stayed healthy.
frictions.resolution: Killed only the identified def2730f6e24__u1r agent-browser daemon tree, reopened the same assigned session name, and used a corroborated janus_access cookie plus plain screenshots/eval reads to capture stable authenticated dashboard evidence.

summary: Tested 7 assigned frontend-hardening auth-surface rerun assertions: 5 passed (VAL-FH-006, VAL-FH-007, VAL-FH-008, VAL-FH-013, VAL-FH-023) and 2 failed (VAL-FH-009, VAL-FH-010). Strongest evidence: credential sign-in and signout both corroborated cleanly through /api/v1/operations/* plus /api/v1/auth/me, while magic-code and reset-password still failed with user-visible errors and backend internal_error "actor not found" outcomes.
